title: Testing Your Code
summary: Testing means checking that code produces the results you expect — not just that it runs without crashing. Even a tiny test saves hours late
learningObjectives: Apply the concept in a small program

sections.content: Testing means checking that code produces the results you expect — not just that it runs without crashing. Even a tiny test saves hours later.
Start manual: run the program with normal input, edge cases (empty, zero, negative), and bad input. Then automate repeated checks as functions so you can re-run them after every change.
Key points: test the boundaries, test what users will actually do, and a failing test tells you exactly what broke.
